about: The App Store declarations cmux makes in App Store Connect: the age rating questionnaire and App Privacy. scripts/ci/ios_asc_ops.py declarations-check diffs ageRating against ASC on every main push (ios-app-review-readiness.yml) and fails on any difference or any ASC field not declared here; App Privacy has no ASC API, so the check prints appPrivacy as the exact block to enter by hand. Change a declaration here first, then apply it: the check's result carries agePatch, the exact --attributes for age-rating-patch.
source: cmuxterm-hq#18638 answers; cmuxterm-hq docs/handbook/ios-app-store-connect-answers.md (evidence pinned at feat-cmux-next 7c4360f0f6b7701ccbb4d6dbb3cb91cca7db42ab). Plain cmux is the App Store app: Aziz, pasted by Leo 2026-11-22 23:44Z: "cmux (no suffix) is what goes to app store".
